**Indikator 4** is a quality metric administered by the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) to monitor and enforce standards of care for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. According to the 2023 annual report, the indicator specifically tracks the systematic follow-up of IBD patients undergoing treatment with biological and targeted synthetic therapies (BMSL) by measuring fecal [[calprotectin|calprotectin]] (F-calpro) [^src1]. The national quality standard for this metric requires that at least 80% of these patients receive an annual measurement [^src1].

During the reporting period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, the national fulfillment rate for Indikator 4 was 78%, meaning the cohort was close to but did not quite meet the 80% threshold [^src1]. Regional performance varied significantly across Denmark: [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] achieved a high fulfillment rate of 94%, while [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] reached 79%, remaining marginally below the national standard [^src1]. 

Notably, there appears to be a discrepancy or redefinition regarding Indikator 4 in subsequent reporting. In the 2024 annual report's regional comments, Region Hovedstaden (RHN) refers to Indikator 4 as the proportion of steroid courses given to IBD patients over the age of 50 who subsequently receive a DEXA scan [^src2]. RHN noted a desire to increase their internal targets for this metric and proposed workflow changes to allow nurses and secretaries in the Gastroenterology department to order DEXA scans directly, with plans to retroactively register and order scans for patients to be included in the 2025 annual report [^src2].

- **Page 47**: "Indikator 4: Andelen af steroidkure givet til patienter over 50 år med IBD, hvor patienten har fået foretaget
DEXA-skanning
RHN har et ønske om at øge egen målsætning ift. denne indikator. Vi vil derfor se på muligheden for en
ændret arbejdsgang, således det bliver muligt for sygeplejersker og sekretærer tilknyttet Med. Mave og
Tarmsygdomme fremadrettet at bestille en DEXA-skanning. Desuden er det besluttet, at vi vil forsøge at få
efterregistreret og bestilt DEXA-skanning på de patienter, som vil blive inkluderet i årsrapporten 2025." [^src2]
